color-match.name: Color match
color-match.seoTitle: Color Match: a Gentle Picture Game
color-match.h1: Color Match: Find the Pictures of One Color
color-match.description: A large color with its name, and four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color. No timer, no score, and another color is simply named. Free to play and print.
color-match.short: Find every picture that is the same color as the one shown.
color-match.players: 1 or 2 people, or an adult and a child
color-match.intro: A large patch of color is shown with its name written beside it, and below it are four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color: a red apple and a red cup, for example. If a picture is another color, the game simply names it ("The pear is green.") and waits. "Show them" points out the pictures that match at any time, and "Another color" moves on.
howTo: Choose four or six pictures. Four is the simplest.
Look at the color and read its name together.
Tap every picture that is that color. Each one gets a thick border and a check mark.
If a picture is another color, the game says what color it is and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show them" whenever you like, then "Another color" for a new color.
tips: Say the color out loud, then look around the room: what else is that color?
Use your own words if you like. "Tomato" or "sky" is as good as "red" or "blue".
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture of another color is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture and its color, such as "The pear is green.", and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: Is color the only clue?
faq.a: No. The color is shown as a large patch and also written as a word, and every picture is named when it is tapped. Someone who finds a color hard to see can still play by reading the name.

faq.q: Is every picture really that color?
faq.a: The pictures are chosen by hand, and only ones where the main object is plainly one color. Pictures with several colors, such as a kite or a bee, are left out.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has four rows. Each row names a color and shows four pictures to point to or circle.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

halves-match.short: Tap the two halves that fit together to make one picture.
halves-match.players: 1 or 2 people, or an adult and a child
halves-match.intro: Each picture is cut down the middle. The left halves of two or three pictures are in one column and their right halves, in a different order, are in the other. Tap a half on the left, then tap the half on the right that fits it, such as the spout of a kettle and its handle. Halves that fit are joined into a whole picture. Halves that do not fit simply separate again, and the game says so gently. "Show me" joins them all.
howTo: Choose two or three pictures. Two is the simplest.
Look at the left halves together. What do you think each one is part of?
Tap a half on the left, then tap the half on the right that fits it. It also works the other way round.
Halves that fit are joined, with a thick border and a check mark. Halves that do not fit separate again, and you can try another.
Tap "Show me" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Trace the edge of a half with a finger. Where does the drawing reach the middle?
Say what you can see: "That one has a handle." There is no need to name every picture.
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if two halves do not fit?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The two halves separate again and the game says, "Those two do not fit together. Try another." Nothing is counted.

faq.q: Are the pictures easy to tell apart?
faq.a: Yes. The pictures are chosen by hand, and two pictures on one board are never from the same group, such as two fruits or two animals. Pictures whose two halves look alike, such as the sun or a rainbow, are left out.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Ẽo. Kɔ ɖeka dzi la, kpɔɖeŋu 3 ƒe akpa ɖeka ɖoa kɔlɔ ɖeka me, eye woƒe akpa bubuwo ɖoa kɔlɔ bubu me le ɖoɖo bubu me. Tsɔ linya tso akpa ɖeka ƒe ɖeŋu yi akpa si dze ɖe eŋu.

faq.q: Ðe ɖeɖe le, eye ɖe ele be nàkplɔ ŋkɔ alo nàdzɔ?
faq.a: Ẽo, ɖeɖe le, eye menye ŋkɔ, nɔnɔme ɖe kpɔɖeŋu alo sɔ ɖe ƒe ŋkɔ hã dze. Ele dɔ wɔm le web browser dzi ɖe ƒo-vidzɔ, ta alo komputa dzi.

color-by-number.name: Aʋa tso nɔmba dzi
color-by-number.seoTitle: Aʋa tso nɔmba dzi: Dɔ ɖeɖe ɖe kɔnɛ gãwo ŋu, si ɖe nu ŋutɔ
color-by-number.h1: Aʋa tso nɔmba dzi: Ƒo kɔnɛwo, aʋa si nèdi ɖe wo ɖe
color-by-number.description: Kɔnɛ gã siwo ŋu nɔmba le, kple aʋa 4 siwo ŋkɔ kple woƒe ŋkɔwo le ɖoɖo me. Tia aʋa aɖe, azɔ tia kɔnɛwo ŋu be woafɔ. Aʋa ɖe ɖeka hã nyo, menye timer alo ɖeƒo le, eye bɔtɔn aɖe fɔa nɔmbawo dzi kɔnɛ siwo ɖo gbɔ. Ɖeɖe kple nu ɖoa ɖeɖe, ɖeɖe ɖe kpɔɖeŋu hã le.
color-by-number.short: Tia aʋa aɖe, emegbe tia kɔnɛ nɔmba siwo ŋu be woafɔ.
color-by-number.players: Ame 1 alo 2, ɖe nu ɖeka dzi
color-by-number.intro: Kɔnɛ gã siwo ŋu nɔmba le, eye ɖoɖo aɖe le anyi dzi, kple aʋa 4 siwo ŋu nɔmba kple ŋkɔ le. Tia aʋa tso ɖoɖo la me, emegbe tia kɔnɛwo be woafɔ. Kɔnɛ ɖoa 4 x 4 le gɔmeɖoɖo, eye 6 x 6 kple 8 x 8 le nu geɖe nèdi ɖe. Ne kɔnɛ sia ɖe sia ƒe aʋa nye ɖe nɔmba ene la, kpɔɖeŋu la nye kpɔɖeŋu ɖe kpɔɖeŋu dzi. Kɔnɛ siwo ƒe aʋa nye aʋa bubu aɖe la, nye wò ŋutɔ wò kpɔɖeŋu, eye ɖeɖe mekpɔa nyuie alo vɔ̃ nu aɖeke o. “Fɔ kple nɔmbawo” fɔa kɔnɛ mavɔ sia ɖe sia nɛ.
howTo: Tia kɔnɛ ƒe gaƒoƒo. 4 x 4 ƒe kɔnɛwo gã wu, eye ɖeka wu.
Kpɔ ɖoɖo si le gɔmeɖoɖo dzi. Aʋa ɖe sia ɖe ŋu nɔmba kple ŋkɔ le, abe 1 Yellow ene.
Tia aʋa aɖe le ɖoɖo la me, azɔ tia kɔnɛwo si nèdi be woaƒo aʋa la ŋu.
Kpɔ aʋa si ŋu nɔmba le dzi alo aʋa bubu si nèdi. Enyo wu ɖeka.
Tia “Fɔ kple nɔmbawo” ɖe kɔnɛ mavɔwo ŋu, “Tu” be wòatrɔ gbɔ ɖe gbã, alo “Kpɔɖeŋu bubu” be wòakpɔ kpɔɖeŋu bubu.
tips: Ɖe nu ɖeka dzi eye ɖe nu nɛ̃ ɖe nu ɖeka ɖe aʋa tia gbe ɖeka, eye ŋutsu bubu tia kɔnɛ la ŋu.
Ɖe nu ɖe aʋawo ŋu: “Menyɔa aʋa tututu la.” Mehiã be nàgblɔ nu si kpɔɖeŋu la nanye o.
Ne ɖoɖo la le sue dzi la, kɔnɛ 8 x 8 la ɖo le ɖoɖo ɖeka me, eye wòanɔ ɖe eme nu nɛ. Kɔnɛwo nɔa ɖe ɖoƒe si nyo ɖe ɖeka ŋu.
Kpɔɖeŋu ɖeka le kpɔɖeŋu si ɖe kpɔɖeŋu ɖe ŋku ŋu, si ɖe ɖe ɖoɖo ɖeka dzi kple ŋku ɖeka ŋu hã nɔa dɔ wɔm.

faq.q: Ðe timer alo ɖeƒo le ɖe?
faq.a: Ðeka o. Menye ɣeyiɖikpɔla, ɖeƒo, nɔnɔme ɖe nu wɔm alo nuɖuɖu aɖeke o. Àte ŋu adzo ɣe si ɖe ɖeka, eye ɖe ɖeƒo ɖe be nàdzo le ɖeka dzi, enye nu nyui aɖe be nàwu dɔ la.

faq.q: Ne mede aʋa si ŋu nɔmba le dzi la, nu kae ɖe dze?
faq.a: Naneke mada o, eye esia nye nu si ɖe ŋu kpɔɖeŋu la. Aʋa ɖesiaɖe ate ŋu ana ɖe kɔnɛ ɖesiaɖe, eye menye nu si ɖe ŋu míegblɔa o. Ne kɔnɛ sia ɖe sia ƒe aʋa nye nɔmba ƒe aʋa la, ɖe gbeƒã gbɔ ɖe ɖa be wòwu dɔ. Kpɔɖeŋu si ɖe wò ŋutɔ wò aʋawo me la hã nyo ene.

faq.q: Ðe ame siwo ƒe ŋku aʋa mele nyuie o ate ŋu aɖe aʋawo ŋu?
faq.a: Wotia be woado ŋu ɖe aʋa ɖeka me. Aʋa sia ɖe sia ƒe nɔmba, ŋkɔ, kple kpɔɖeŋu kakã aɖe hã le, nenema aʋa mele ŋu be ɖeka ɖoa ɖe wo dzi o. Woƒo aʋa 4 la kple simulation siwo ŋu ame siwo ƒe ŋku aʋa mele nyuie le ɖe ŋu ɖe kpɔ, eye wo hã dze nu si nye kɔ nɔ ɖoɖo me. Ame si ƒe ŋku aʋa mele nyuie aɖeke menɔ ɖoɖo sia ɖi ɖo o, eya ta gblɔ mía si ne aʋa eve aɖe kpɔa ɖe nu ɖeka ene.

faq.q: Ðe kɔnɛwo gã wu be ame si ŋuti, alo ɖe ɖoƒe si tsi ate ŋu akpɔ wo?
faq.a: Kɔnɛ sia ɖe sia ƒe ɖoƒe tɔ 48 pixel bliboa, eye 4 x 4 ɖoɖo la me, 56. Ne ɖoɖo ɖe gã wu ɖoƒe la, ɖoɖo la ana le eme nu nɛ le ɖoƒe ŋutɔ la me, eye menye ɖe kɔnɛwo ƒe ɖoƒe yiyi o.

faq.q: Ðe ɖoɖo ɖe kpɔɖeŋu le ɖe?
faq.a: Ẽo. Kɔ ɖeka dzi la, nɔmba kɔnɛ kple aʋa 4 le ɖoɖo ŋkɔ kple wo ƒe ŋkɔwo. Tia kɔnɛ sia ɖe sia me nu aʋa si ŋu nɔmba le la, alo aʋa bubu si nèdi.

faq.q: Ðe ɖeɖe le, eye ɖe ele be nàkplɔ ŋkɔ alo nàdzɔ?
faq.a: Ẽo, ɖeɖe le, eye menye ŋkɔ, nɔnɔme ɖe kpɔɖeŋu alo sɔ ɖe ƒe ŋkɔ hã dze. Ele dɔ wɔm le web browser dzi ɖe ƒo-vidzɔ, ta alo komputa dzi.

pattern-maker.name: Kpɔɖeŋu wɔla
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Kpɔɖeŋu wɔla: Wɔ kpɔɖeŋu ɖe ɖeka, eye nàfɔ kpɔɖeŋu la
pattern-maker.h1: Kpɔɖeŋu wɔla: Wɔ kpɔɖeŋu ɖe ɖeka, eye nàkpɔ ale si wòdze ɖe eŋu
pattern-maker.description: Trɔ kɔnɛwo ƒe ɖoƒe ɖe kpɔɖeŋu kakã ɖeka me, eye kpɔ ale si wòdze ɖe eŋu be wòɖoa kpɔɖeŋu nɔa gbɔ, kple aʋa 4 siwo ɖesiaɖe ŋkɔ kple kpɔɖeŋu kakã le. Menye ɣeyiɖikpɔla alo ɖeƒo aɖeke o. Ɖeɖe kple nu ɖoa ɖeɖe ɖe ɖe kpɔɖeŋu.
pattern-maker.short: Trɔ kɔnɛwo ƒe ɖoƒe ɖe kpɔɖeŋu kakã aɖe me, eye kpɔ ale si wòdze ɖe eŋu.
pattern-maker.players: Ame 1 alo 2, ɖe nu ɖeka dzi
pattern-maker.intro: Kpɔɖeŋu kakã aɖe si kɔnɛ 3 x 3 le, alo 4 x 4 ne èdi, eye ɖe eme la, “kpɔɖeŋu wò”: kpɔɖeŋu kakã ya ɖe ɖoɖo aɖe me. Tia kɔnɛ aɖe, eye wòtrɔ ɖe aʋa 4 si ŋu ŋkɔ kple kpɔɖeŋu kakã sia ɖe sia le me ɖe nu ɖeka ŋu. Kpɔɖeŋu si ɖe eme la trɔ kpeɖodzi. Kpɔɖeŋu nyui aɖeke mele eme o, eye naneke mesɔa o alo mede ɖe asi o. “Fɔ kpɔɖeŋu nye” fɔa kpɔɖeŋu si ɖo ɖa ɖe kpɔɖeŋu ɖeka dzi, be nàkpɔ, nàɖo aʋa ɖe, alo nànana ame bubu.
howTo: Kpɔ kpɔɖeŋu kakã kple kpɔɖeŋu wò si ɖe eme la. Wo nye kpɔɖeŋu kakã ɖeka, si wodo ɖa ɖe ɖoɖo me.
Tia kɔnɛ aɖe. Wòtrɔ ɖe aʋa si ɖe ŋgɔ la le aʋa 4 siwo le ɖoɖo si ɖe ɖe la me.
Tia kɔnɛwo ɖe ɖe kpɔɖeŋu la nɔ abe ale si nèdi ene. Kpɔɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe nye nu nyui.
Tia “Nu yeyea nam” be nàkpɔ kpɔɖeŋu kakã yeye, alo “Ɖo ɖa gbã” be nàkpɔ kpɔɖeŋu si mete ŋu o. “Tsɔ gbɔ” ɖoa kpɔɖeŋu si nèkpɔ tẽ la gbɔ.
Tia “Fɔ kpɔɖeŋu nye” ne èdi be woatsɔ ɖe kpɔɖeŋu si ɖe ɖe ɖe, alo tia Nɔ ɖe be nàɖo ɖa.
tips: Nɔ ɖe ɖeka ɖe nu eve me, eye mi ɖeka nɔ ɖe ɖoɖo le ɖeka ƒe ɖoɖo dzi, eye ɖeka nɔ ɖe ɖoɖo ɖe nu si wòkpɔna.
Gblɔ nu si miekpɔna: "Esia ɖe ɖetsi." Menye be miɖe nu ɖe ŋkɔ aɖeke ŋu o.
Wɔ ɖoɖo ɖeka ɖe kɔlɔ eve me, azɔ wɔ ɖe kɔlɔ ene me.
Ne ɖoɖo la le kpukpui dzi la, miate ŋu aɖe kɔlɔ ɖe dzi, alo aɖo ɖe ŋgɔ ɖe akɔ̃ɖi, alo aɖo ɖe ɖe nu ɖe ɖeka ƒe nu ɖe ɖe nunɔamesi ɖe ɖe nu.

faq.q: Ðe ɣeyiɣi alo ɖoɖo kpɔɖeŋu li?
faq.a: Ao. Ɣeyiɣi aɖeke, kpɔɖeŋu aɖeke, nu ɖoɖo aɖeke alo ɖeŋu aɖeke mele afi sia o. Miate ŋu aɖe ɖe ɣeyiɣi sia ɣi kpɔ ɖe ɖeɖe ɖe ɣeyiɣi ɖe ɖe, eye ɖe ɖoɖo ɖe ɖeka ɖe ɖoɖo ɖe nu, eye ɖe ɖoɖo ɖe nu ɖe ɖeka ɖe nu nyuie ɖe ɖeka ɖe ɖoɖo.

faq.q: Ðe nu si mewɔ la ɖe ɖe ɖe alo wodzea ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Ao. Wò kɔlɔ la nɔ afi sia ko. Wodzea ɖe ɖe, wodzea ɖe ɖe, eye womekpɔa ɖe ɖe o, eye wòdzo ne ètɔ̃ ɖe kpɔ ɖa. Ne èdi be nàkpɔ ɖoɖo la ɖa la, trɔ̃ ɖe ɖe.

faq.q: Ŋu ɖe nu wɔ nɔ kɔlɔ ɖe ɖe alo nu ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe nu ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Nu si nèwɔ ɖe ɖe o nye ɖe, eye nàtrɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe nu ɖe ɖe ŋgɔ ɖe ɖe. Ɖe "Ɖo ɖe ɖoɖo" alo "Nu si ɖe" ɖe ɖe ɖe la, "Trɔ̃ ɖe ɖe" ɖea kɔlɔ si nèle ɖe ɖe ɖe.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each square, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Ðe kpukpui la gbɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe alo ɖe ɖe ɖe kpukpui sue?
faq.a: Every square is at least 56 pixels across. If the tile is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Ao. "Trɔ̃ ɖoɖo ɖe" ɖe ɖoɖo si nèwɔ ɖe kpukpui ɖeka dzi, kple kɔlɔ ene kple woƒe ŋkɔwo. Ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe nu ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe, ɖoɖo la ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe, elabena kɔlɔ ɖeka ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe.

faq.q: Ðe wòɖoa ɖe kpɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe, eye ele be nàkɔ nkɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

drawing-duet.short: Take turns drawing one shared picture with someone beside you.
drawing-duet.intro: Kɔlɔ ɖeka, ame eve. Ame ɖesiaɖe ɖe kɔlɔ ɖeka ɖe, eye kɔlɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe ŋkɔ li. Trɔ̃ ɖe ɖe: ɖe ɖeka alo ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe, azɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe. Ame ɖesiaɖe ate ŋu aɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe. Ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe. Ne ɖe ɖe la nyo la, nàɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe, alo nàɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe: kpukpui ɖeka, kalame eve.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. The banner says whose turn it is, with that person's color by name.
Draw one line or shape with a finger, a mouse or a pen. Or use the arrow keys and Space to draw without a pointer.
Ne èɖo ɖe la, ɖe "Ɖe kalame la" ɖe ɖe ɖe. Ame ɖesiaɖe ate ŋu aɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe.
Tap "Take back my last line" to remove the newest line of the person whose turn it is.
Ɖe "Dzra ɖe ɖe ɖe" ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe, alo "Ɖo ɖe ɖoɖo ɖe" ɖe kpukpui ɖeka kple kalame eve.
tips: Nɔ ɖe ɖeka ɖe nu eve me, eye miɖe ŋgɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe: "Makpe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe."
Ɖo ɖe ɖoɖo, ɖeka, alo ɖe ɖeka ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe.
Nobody has to draw a picture of anything. A pattern of lines is just as good as a scene.
Ne èdi be nàɖo ɖe la, ɖe "Ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe" ɖe ɖe. Wòɖea ɖe kpɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe nu alo nàdzra ɖe ɖe.

faq.q: Ðe ɖeŋu alo kpɔɖeŋu li?
faq.a: Ao. Ɖeŋu aɖeke, kpɔɖeŋu aɖeke, ɣeyiɣi aɖeke, alo ŋkɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe aɖeke mele afi sia o. Ɖoɖo ɖe ɖe ɖe aɖeke meli o, eye nu aɖeke metsoa ɖe ɖe ɖe alo nu ɖe ɖe ɖe o.

faq.q: Ðe wodzra alo wodzea nu si wɔm ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Ao, nu aɖeke meɖea ɖe afi aɖeke o. Ɖoɖo la nɔ afi sia ɖe nusi nèɖe ɖe. Ne èɖo "Dzra ɖoɖo" la, woɖo fayl ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe nàɖo ɖe ɖe. Womekɔa nu aɖeke ɖe ɖe o.

faq.q: Ðe mate ŋu atrɔ kalame si nèwɔ ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Ɛɛ. "Trɔ̃ ɖe kalame ɖe ɖe" ɖea kalame si ame si ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe. "Ɖo ɖe ɖoɖo" ɖea kpukpui la ɖe, eye "Trɔ̃ ɖe" ɖea kalame ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖeka ɖe.

faq.q: Ðe mate ŋu aɖo ɖe ɖe kple mouse alo ŋku ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Ɛɛ. Ne ɖoɖo la ɖe ɖe ɖe la, arrow keys ɖe ɖe ɖe kalame ɖe, eye Space key ɖe kalame ɖe alo ɖe ɖe. Ɖe la gblɔ "Pen down" alo "Pen up" ɣe sia ɣe.

faq.q: Kɔlɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe, eye ame siwo ɖe kɔlɔ ɖe ɖe ate ŋu ada ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green kple purple, kɔlɔ ene siwo míaƒe ɖoɖo ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe. Kɔlɔ ɖesiaɖe li ŋkɔ si woŋlɔ, eye ŋkɔwo ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe. Woɖo kɔlɔwo ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe, ke ame si ɖe kɔlɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe mekpɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe o.

faq.q: Ðe ɖoɖo ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Ɛɛ. "Trɔ̃ ɖoɖo ɖe ɖe" ɖea kpukpui ɖeka si ŋu sɔ̃ƒe ɖe ɖe ɖe, kple frame gã aɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ame eve kple kalame eve. Edzena ɖe black and white dzi hã.

faq.q: Ðe wòɖoa ɖe kpɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe, eye ele be nàkɔ nkɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Ee, bubu nye, eye ame aɖeke megadzo nɛ, eye mahiã nuɖoɖo, kpɔɖeŋu alo ɖoɖo kple wò ɖoɖo, hã. Edzea dɔ le web-browser me le wò fɔnu, sitsitsi alo komputa me.

build-together.name: Build together
build-together.seoTitle: Build Together: Ame eve ɖoa ŋɔŋlɔ ɖeka
build-together.h1: Build Together: Ame eve, Grid ɖeka
build-together.description: Ame eve trɔ sɔ ɖe grid ɖeka me le ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe me va se ɖe esime wòfɔ, eye wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe tsɔ ŋutinya kple ŋkɔ kple ŋɔŋlɔ si wom. Ame aɖeke madze eŋu o, eye ɣeyiɣi alo dzidzedze aɖeke mele afisia o. Ewɔa ɖe mɔ dzidzɔ, eye ate ŋu ada hã.
build-together.short: Trɔ sɔ kple ame si le gbɔwò be woafɔ grid ɖeka si wo dometɔ.
build-together.intro: Grid ɖeka si wo dometɔ ŋu nɔ — 4 le 4 alo 3 le 3, ne èdi nenema. Ame ɖesiaɖe tia ŋutinya ɖe, eye ŋutinya ɖesiaɖe kple ŋkɔ kple ŋɔŋlɔ si wom le ŋu. Trɔ sɔ: le wò ɣeyiɣi me la, tsi kpɔ ɖe ƒuƒlu si mele ɖe ɖa be nàdo wò akpa afisia. Ne ƒuƒlu ɖesiaɖe ɖo akpa ɖe la, ŋɔŋlɔ la doa ɖe ame eve ŋu. Ame aɖeke madze eŋu o, elabena miawɔe kple ame eve, eye naneke mele ŋutɔ alo mele ŋutɔ le dzi o. "Print the grid" ŋlɔa grid ɖe kpe ɖeka dzi be miaɖo kple ɖoɖo eve.
howTo: Ame ɖesiaɖe tia ŋutinya ɖe. Ŋutinya si ame bubu si le ɖe la, woŋlɔa "In use" ŋu.
Ame gbɔgbɔ ɖoa ɖe gbɔ. Ŋutinya la gblɔa ame si ŋu trɔ nye, kple ŋutinya si nye ame sia ƒe.
Tsi kpɔ ɖe ƒuƒlu si mele ɖe ɖa be nàdo akpa wò afisia. Trɔ la doa ame bubu ŋu.
Ne àdi be màdo akpa o la, tsi "Pass". Ame eve ate ŋu awɔ esia ɣeyiɣi ɖesiaɖe.
Ne ƒuƒlu ɖesiaɖe ɖo akpa ɖe la, miewɔ ŋɔŋlɔ la ɖekae. Tsi "Start again" be nàwɔ bubu, alo tsi Rest be nàdzudzɔ.
tips: Nɔ gbɔ ɖeka be miate ŋu akpɔ eye miate ŋu aɖo asi ɖe screen la dzi. Ƒo nu ne miewɔ dɔ: "Nye akpa ɖo ŋgɔ wò."
Ɖo ŋui be miawɔ ɖoɖo, abe ŋkɔwo, blo-wo alo teƒe ɖe, alo ɖo akpa kpɔtɔ si nèdi. Nu evelia nyo.
Ame si dzi dzudzɔ kaka alo ame si ɖoa mɔ dzi ɖe nu ate ŋu atrɔ sɔ kple ame eve ƒe ɣeyiɣi. Ŋɔŋlɔ la ɖoa ɖe ame eve ŋu hã.
Le kpe dzi la, ame ɖesiaɖe kpɔa pensil ɖeka eye wòdzea eƒe ŋutinya ɖe kpe si mele ɖe ɖa dzi.

faq.q: Ðe ame aɖeke doa dzi, ɣeyiɣi alo dzidzedze aɖe?
faq.a: Ao. Ame aɖeke madoa dzi o, elabena miaɖo ŋɔŋlɔ ɖeka ɖekae. Ɣeyiɣi, dzidzedze, akpa ƒomevi alo ame si dzi woɖiɖi aɖeke menɔ afisia o. Ate ŋu ana ɖoɖo ɣe ɖesiaɖe, eye ɖoɖo ɖe ɖa ɖe mɔ nyui ɖe be woawu dɔa.

faq.q: Ðe woakpɔ alo wodɔ nu si míewɔ?
faq.a: Ao. Grid la nɔa ŋutɔ ɖe kpe sia dzi. Womekpɔa, womedɔa, alo womeŋlɔa o, eye woaɖe ɖa ne èɖo kpe la. Ne èdi be nàkpɔ ɖe asi la, print grid la eye nàwɔ ɖe kpe dzi kple pensil.

faq.q: Ne megbɔ ƒuƒlu le teƒe si menye nenem o la, nye ka?
faq.a: Teƒe aɖeke menye nenem o. Tsi "Take back the last piece", eye trɔ la gbɔna nawo. Ate ŋu ana ɖeka ɖeka, eye woate ŋu agbugbɔ pass hã.

faq.q: Ðe ame siwo ƒe ŋku mekpɔa nyuie ate ŋu ade ŋutinyawo dzi?
faq.a: Wotia wo be woate ŋu ade dzi. Ŋutinya ɖesiaɖe kpɔa ŋkɔ kple ŋɔŋlɔ ɖe eme eye ɖoɖo nue aɖe ɖe ƒuƒlu ɖesiaɖe me, eya ta ŋutinya mele nu ɖeka ko si le ŋuti ɖe nu ŋu o. Wodo ŋutinyawo kple simulations si ɖea ŋku ɖe ŋutinya abe ɖe ŋutinya, eye ŋutinya blue kple yellow. Ame si ŋu ŋku mekpɔa nyuie mele wo dzi ɣeaɖewoɖe hafi o, eya ta gblɔ mí ne ŋutinya eve le abe ɖe ɖesi la.

faq.q: Ðe teƒe wo lolo ɖe be ame si dzi lɔlɔ̃ alo screen si tsitsi ate ŋu akpɔ wo?
faq.a: Teƒe ɖesiaɖe lolo wu pixel 56. Ne grid la gbɔ wu screen la, edze ɖe yome le eƒe box me, menye be woado teƒe la ɖe ɖe o.

faq.q: Ðe ɖoɖo ɖe kpe le sia?
faq.a: Ẽ. "Print the grid" ŋlɔa grid ɖeka ɖe kpe ɖeka dzi kple ŋutinya eve kple woƒe ŋkɔwo, be miaɖo kple pensil eve. Edzea dɔ le nuŋɔŋlɔ dzo kple nu ŋɔŋlɔ ɖe nɔnɔme, elabena ŋutinya ɖesiaɖe kpɔa blo nue ɖeka.

faq.q: Ðe edzea ɖe ganyawo, eye ɖe ele be mana nyɔnu alo nyɔnunu?
faq.a: Ẽ, eyae ame aɖeke megadzo nɛ o, eye mahiã nuɖoɖo, kpɔɖeŋu alo ɖoɖo hã o. Edzea dɔ le web-browser me le wò fɔnu, sitsitsi alo komputa me.

seated-toss.name: Seated toss tally
seated-toss.seoTitle: Seated Toss Tally: Dzesi Dzadzɔ-Blo Ƒuƒlu Eve
seated-toss.h1: Seated Toss Tally: Mi dzi blo le tebla dzi
seated-toss.description: Ame eve le tebla ɖe dzi trɔ sɔ be woadzi dzadzɔ-blo si yɔ ŋu ɖe nu gã aɖe me, eye woaŋlɔ ŋutinya ɖe kpe dzi. Ame aɖeke madze eŋu o, eye ɣeyiɣi alo ŋutinya aɖeke megaŋlɔ o. Ate ŋu adzudzɔ ɖe mɔ dzidzɔ.
seated-toss.short: Trɔ sɔ be woadzi dzadzɔ-blo ɖe nu gã aɖe dzi, eye ŋutinya le kpe dzi.
seated-toss.intro: Dzesi dzadzɔ-blo si dzudzɔ ɖe, si wɔna ame eve le tebla ɖe dzi nɔnɔme. Afi ɖe nu gã si woŋlɔ ɖe nu ɖe tebla la dzi, eye trɔ sɔ be woadzi dzadzɔ-blo yɔ, alo kpe si wotsɔ vu le ɖa, ale be wòadze ɖe nu gã la me. Ame ɖesiaɖe tia ŋutinya ɖe kpe la me le ti ɖe kpe si nye ta la me, eye miakpɔ ti la ɖe ɖekae ne miedzudzɔ. Ame aɖeke madze ɣeyiɣi alo akpa o, naneke mele screen la dzi o, eye naneke madoa dzi alo madɔ o. Kpɔ nu ɖi nu siwo le xexlẽdzesi ŋu, elabena ahɔhɔ sue mele ɖe nu sia.
howTo: Kpɔ nu ɖi nu siwo le xexlẽdzesi ŋu. Tia dzadzɔ-blo si woƒe ɖeŋu nye tsitsi alo ka kpakpa ɖe.
Tsi "Print the target and tally sheet" eye nàtsɔ kpe la ɖe tebla dzi ɖe mí dome.
Nɔ anyi nyuie, ame ɖeka le kpɔɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe, eye trɔ sɔ be woadzi ɖe didi ɖeka ɖeka. Ame ɖesiaɖe ate ŋu agbugbɔ pass.
Ne dzadzɔ-blo la dzo ɖe nu gã la me la, tia kpe si le ɖe ɖa be ele wò dzi kple ɖe kpe si ɖe nu gã ma ŋu.
Kpɔ ti la ɖe ɖekae ne miedzudzɔ, alo tsi Rest be nàdzudzɔ.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "Eʋe nyui." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Ðe ŋɔŋɔ alo ŋutinya li?
faq.a: Ao. Ŋutinya, nyatakaka alo ŋutinya ŋutɔ alo ŋutinya ŋutɔ mele wo o. Ate ŋu aɖo ɣeyiɣi sia nu ɖe ɣeyiɣi sia me, eye ɖoɖo ɖe ɖeka ɖoɖo nyuie le ɖoɖo ɖe ɖeka me.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: Ate ŋu anɔ nyui, ne miwɔa nyuie. Kpɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: Ao. Nyatakaka le agbalẽ dzi ɖeka ko, le bokɔwo me, si miawo ɖoa ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe.

faq.q: Ne ame aɖeke mate ŋu aɖo alo kpukpui la ɖe agbalẽ la dzi o gɔ̃ hã?
faq.a: Ame sia ame ate ŋu aɖo ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe. Kpukpui si ɖe agbalẽ la dzi o la, woaɖe eye woayi ɖe ɖoɖo sɛgbe. Womenaŋlɔ nɛ o.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a large target with its three rings named Near, Middle and Far, a table with a column for each person and a row of small boxes to tick for each ring, and a line of safety advice. The names are written on the rings, so it works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seasonal-pack.name: Seasonal puzzle pack
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Printable Paper Puzzles
seasonal-pack.h1: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Three Paper Puzzles for Each Season
seasonal-pack.description: Three small printable puzzles for spring, summer, autumn or winter: match the pairs, circle the one that is different, and color a picture in. Choose a season, or take a rest day. Free to print.
seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the season you choose, or a rest day.
seasonal-pack.players: All ages, solo or side by side
seasonal-pack.intro: Choose a season, and the page shows three small paper puzzles drawn from that season's pictures: two rows to join with lines, a row of four to circle the one that is different, and a picture to color in. You print one page, then do one, two or all three, at your own pace. Choose "Today is a rest day" instead and there is nothing to do.
howTo: Choose a season, or choose "Today is a rest day".
Look at the three puzzles, then tap "Print this season's pack".
Do one, two or all three, at your own pace.
Join the matching pictures with a line, circle the one that is different, and color the large picture in.
Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Ðe ŋɔŋɔ alo ŋutinya li?
faq.a: Ao. Ŋutinya, nyatakaka alo ŋutinya ŋutɔ alo ŋutinya ŋutɔ mele wo o. Ate ŋu aɖo ɣeyiɣi sia nu ɖe ɣeyiɣi sia me, eye ɖoɖo ɖe ɖeka ɖoɖo nyuie le ɖoɖo ɖe ɖeka me.

faq.q: Ðe agbalẽ la nya ɣeyiɣi si wòle ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Ao. Wò ɖe ɣeyiɣi la ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe. Agbalẽ la mekpɔa ɣeyiɣi alo wò nɔƒe o.

faq.q: Ðe ŋɔŋɔ alo nya nyui ɖeka li?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or checked on the screen, and no answers are shown. Each puzzle is only a picture to look at, join, circle or color.

faq.q: Ne ame aɖeke mede dzi ɖe puzzle egbe o gɔ̃ hã?
faq.a: Choose "Today is a rest day". The page then shows one calm line, and there is nothing to print or do.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page for the season you chose: its three puzzles, each with a short line of how to do it, and a line saying you can do one, two or all three.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

decorate-a-card.name: Decorate a card together
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Tia ɣeyiɣi ɖeka, emegbe ƒo “Ɖa kaɖi la” ɖe ŋu.
Ɖo kpukpui la ɖe ɖeka le lalam ɖe ŋu, si nye ɖoɖo, ale be ŋgɔ la nɔ dzi le dziƒo.
Ame ɖeka ɖea ŋgɔ la ɖe ŋu, eye ame bubu la ɖea megbe la ɖe ŋu, alo mi tsɔ ŋgɔ ɖeka ɖea ɖe ŋu.
Ŋlɔ gbedeasi ɖeka ɖekae. Ame ɖeka ate ŋu aŋlɔ, eye ame bubu la ate ŋu aƒo nu.
Gbe ɖe ɖoɖo sɔsrɔ̃ ɖe ɖeɖe ŋu. Kaɖi si me nu le ɖe o la nye nu nyui ke.
tips: Kezi ŋkɔ si le ŋgɔ la ɖe dzi, emegbe ɖe ɖe nuɖuɖu, ɖuɖu alo dzo ɖe edzi, ɖeka ɖeka.
Ne ame aɖe medi ɖe kaɖi ɖe o la, ate ŋu aɖo ŋku ɖe nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe ŋkɔ alo gbedeasi ɖe.
Gblɔ nu si nàlɔ̃ ɖe nu si ame bubu ɖe ɖo la ŋu, eye mègabia be ɖe nyuie alo o.
Ɖo kaɖi la le afi si woate ŋu ana, alo ɖa ɖe tebolo dzi ɖe ɣeyiɣi ɖeka.

faq.q: Ɖe kɔkɔ alo ɖoɖo ɖe le ɖa?
faq.a: Ao. Kɔkɔ, ɖoɖo, nu ɖe ɖoɖo alo ɖeɖe ɖeka aɖeke mele afi ɖeka. Ate ŋu ada ɖe ɣeyiɣi ɖeka, eye ada ɖe ɣeyiɣi tsitsi le ŋutɔ ɖoɖo nyui ɖeka.

faq.q: Ele be míakɔ gɔmi, akpɔmɔ alo dɔkɔ ɖe kaɖi?
faq.a: Ao. Kreyɔn, kɔlɔ pɛnsel alo felt-tip pɛn ɖeka ɖoe. Ele be míakɔ, míakɔ gɔmi, alo míadze ɖe kaɖi o.

faq.q: Ate ŋu aɖo kaɖi na ɣeyiɣi si mele ŋkɔ la me o?
faq.a: Ɖo “Ne mede dzi ɖe nye nu o” eye ŋlɔ nye nya ɖe ŋgɔ la ɖe dzi, alo ɖo kaɖi la kple ɣeyiɣi aɖeke o.

faq.q: Ðe wotsɔa nu, kpɔa nu alo ɖe kɔ ɖe ŋutɔ la dzi?
faq.a: Ao. Ŋutɔ la ɖea kaɖi kple nuwɔwɔ ɖeka ɖeka. Wodzea nu ɖe ɖoɖo ŋu, wodzea kɔ alo ɖe kaɖi ɖe ɖeka o, eye kaɖi nyui aɖeke mele ɖe o.

faq.q: Nu kae le kpukpui si woɖa ɖe la dzi?
faq.a: Kpukpui 1: kaɖi si wotsɔ ɖo ɖe ɖeka, kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe nyataɖo kple dzidzim ɖeka le ŋgɔ la dzi, eye lalam ɖe nu kple nyatakaka le megbe. Nuɖoɖo siwo sɔ na ame eve le ŋutɔ la dzi, wodzi wo ɖe alafa la me.

faq.q: Ðe wòle be ɖe ŋu wɔm, eye ele be míaɖe nyatakaka ɖe?
faq.a: Ẽ, wòle nu ɖe o, eye nyatakaka alo ɖoɖo ɖa o, alo akpɔ gbugbɔ ɖe o. Edzea dɔ le web browser ɖe telefon, tablet alo kɔmpiuta dzi.

find-together.name: Ɖe kpɔ ɖekae
find-together.seoTitle: Ɖe kpɔ ɖekae: Ame eve ɖea nɔnɔme la
find-together.h1: Ɖe kpɔ ɖekae: Ame eve, dɔwɔla ɖeka
find-together.description: Ame eve ɖea skrini ɖeka, eye woda ɖe ɖeka ɖe ŋu ɖe kaɖi nɔnɔme eve dzi ɖe nɔnɔme ɖe kpɔm. Woɖea nɔnɔme siwo kpɔna ɖekae, eye woɖoa ɖe tally ɖeka ŋu. Wɔnɔ ɖeka ɖe o, gake ɖe timer alo score aɖeke o.
find-together.short: Dɔwɔ ɖeka kple ame si le ɖe asi ɖe nɔnɔme kpɔm ɖe ɖeka ɖe kpɔ.
find-together.intro: Kaɖi lɔlɔ̃ hena ŋkɔ hena woɖea wo le ŋgɔ, alo woagbɔ wo le anyigba ŋu. Le ɖe ɖe dzi la, ɖe kaɖi eve. Ne wo nye nɔnɔme ɖeka, wokpɔ nɔnɔme kpɔ, eye ɖe ɖe ɖea ɖe megbe. Ne wo nye nɔnɔme ɖe nɔnɔme ɖe, wonɔ ɖe dzi va se ne mièfɔ “Tsɔ wo ɖo ɖe anyigba” ɖe, ale be mia dometɔwo ate ŋu akpɔe. Àte ŋu aɖe ɖe ɣeyiɣi sia sia. Tally si le ta la kɔ ɖe ɖoɖo ɖe, ɖeka ɖeka: nɔnɔme siwo mikpɔna ɖekae.
howTo: Ɖo ɖe kaɖi tsɔ kaɖi 6, nɔnɔme 3, nye nu si le ɖe ɖeka nyui ɖe ɖe ɖoɖo.
Skrini la gblɔ ame si ɖe ɖoɖo la, kple circle na ame gbãtɔ kple square na ame evelia.

Ne wo nye nɔnɔme ɖe nɔnɔme ɖe, ƒo “Tsɔ wo ɖo ɖe anyigba” ne mièle ɖe ɖoɖo ɖe. Ɖoɖo la ɖea ɖe megbe.

Woɖe fotoa ɖeka ɖeka ƒe kpekpe eve. Tsɔ ɖeka eye nàtsɔ eƒe kpekpe la.
Ne èdi la, ɖo nyatakaka sue aɖe ɖe fotoa ƒe ta. Woamegblɔ nyatakakawo o.
Ɖo nu ɖe fotoa ɖeka ɖeka ŋu ne èkpɔ wo.
Ne èwu wò dɔ la, dzudzɔ ɖoƒe alo tsɔ "Tu fotowo" la. Naneke maɖi o.
tips: Tia foto siwo me kɔ siwo me dzidzɔ le, nusiwo nènya nyuie: aƒemelã, abɔ, teƒe si nèlɔ̃na wu, srɔ̃ɖegbe.
Teƒewo kple nuwo ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo ɖeɖe ate ŋu anɔ bɔbɔe wu mo, eye woƒoa asa na nyaƒoɖeamenu ɖesiaɖe be woayɔ amewo ƒe ŋkɔ.
Gblẽ ame siwo ku ƒe fotowo ɖi ne woate ŋu ahe nuxaxa kpata vɛ, negbe ɖe nènya be wohea akɔfafa vɛ hafi.

picture-bingo.short: Bingo-kaɖi siwo ƒe nɔnɔmetata woate ŋu ata kple kaƒomɔ̃ gã aɖe na ƒuƒoƒowo.
picture-bingo.players: Ƒuƒoƒo si me ame 2 va ɖo 30 le
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo si wonya nyuie si me nɔnɔmetatawo le ɖe xexlẽdzesiwo teƒe, eyata mehiã be ame aɖeke naxlẽ nuŋɔŋlɔ suewo o. Ta agbalẽvi tɔxɛ aɖewo, emegbe nàzã kaƒomɔ̃ si le screen dzi atsɔ aɖe nɔnɔmetata ɖesiaɖe si lolo afia le TV, kɔmpiuta alo tablɛt dzi.

Zi "Ta agbalẽviwo" dzi. Kpekpeɖeŋugbalẽvi ɖesiaɖe to vovo.
Ʋu ame si le ka ƒom la le screen gã aɖe dzi. Zi "Next picture" dzi be nàɖe nɔnɔmetata ɖesiaɖe kple eƒe ŋkɔ afia.
Fefewɔlawo tsɔa gaku, abɔta alo dzesidenu tsyɔa nɔnɔmetata si sɔ ɖe enu le woƒe kaɖi dzi.
Amesiame si yɔ fli ɖeka, alo agbalẽvi bliboa ɖo la, kpɔa dzidzɔ. Ame aɖeke meda le gɔmeɖeɖe sia me o: yi edzi nànɔ fefem vaseɖe esime fli nanɔ amesiame si.
tips: Zã dzesi gãwo abe checkers alo aŋetuwo ƒe nutrenuwo ene. Ate ŋu asesẽ be woafɔ abɔta suewo.
Yɔ nɔnɔmetata la ŋkɔ eye nàgblɔ nya aɖe tso eŋu: "Tɔdziʋu si wotsɔa ʋuʋudedi wɔe. Amekae do le tɔdziʋu me kpɔ?"
Nɔ anyi na amesiwo wòsesẽna be woakpɔ wo le teƒe si te ɖe screen la ŋu wu, eye nàtsɔ kpeɖeŋutɔwo akpe ɖe fefewɔla siwo hiã wo ŋu.
Dzogoe enyi sɔ gbɔ na ƒuƒoƒo akpa gãtɔ. Na kpekpea nanɔ abe miniti 20 va ɖo 30 ene.

faq.q: Aleke mawɔ aƒu du le foto bingo me le dɔnɔdzikpɔƒe?

faq.q: Ðe woate ŋu ata agbalẽ faaa?
faq.a: Ɛ̃. Ta agbalẽvi agbɔsɔsɔme si nèhiã, zi alesi nèdi, na wò ŋutɔ alo ƒuƒoƒo ƒe zazã.

picnic-planner.intro: Ɖe asi ɖe nuɖuɖu kple nu si woawɔ ɖe ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me ƒe kpekpewo dzi be woatsɔ ayi ŋdi ƒe agbe si me ekpɔ ɖe ƒe eve. Gbe aɖe si le gbe me gblɔa nu si le agbe la me, abe "Mía ŋdi: abolo, shi, apolo kple kite." Ekema ɖe "Mina míakpe ɖe mía ŋdi ŋu" be woaɖe kpekpe nuwɔƒe dze ɖoɖoe si wotia tso kpekpewo me. Kpekpewo anɔ kpɔm, eye womeɖoa ɣeyiɣi, womeɖoa wɔnuku alo ɖe ŋu o, eye womesiaa wo o. "Tɔ mía ŋdi ƒe nuwɔƒe" kplɔa nu tsɔ tsɔ ɖe ŋkɔ si nèti ŋu, eye ele kɔnyinyi kple ɖeƒe ɖe nu si wòɖea tɔ ɖe ŋu ɖe.
howTo: Ɖe asi ɖe nuɖuɖu alo nu si woawɔ ɖe ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me ƒe kpekpe dzi. Ele agbe la me.
Ɖe asi ɖe kpekpe si le agbe la me dzi be nàtsɔe ɖe eme.
Tia nu eve alo wu, azɔ ɖe "Mina míakpe ɖe mía ŋdi ŋu" dzi.
Ɖe kpekpe eve si nɔ ɖeka ɖe dzi. Kpekpewo nɔa kpɔm, eya ta naneke mahiã be nàkpɔ ɖa o.
Ɖe "Tɔ mía ŋdi ƒe nuwɔƒe" dzi be nàaɖo ŋkɔ si ŋu nèkpɔ ɖa ɖe ƒo ɖe ŋu.
tips: Bia ame siwo le ɖe mía ŋu be woadi be woaɖe nu kae, eye mi katã mia nɔ nu tia kpekpewo ɖekae.
Gblɔ nu ɖe kpekpe ɖeka ɖeka ŋu ne ele agbe la me: "Èkpɔa ŋkɔ kite si mí de to ɖe ŋdɔ dzi la oa?"
Ɖe ŋkɔ mee la, ɖikeke siwo le ŋkɔwo dzi la na nu bubu si nàdi be woaɖe ɖe nuwɔƒe la me, alo ŋkɔ aɖe.

faq.q: Ðe ɣeyiɣi ɖoɖo, ŋkɔ ɖoɖo, alo ame si dzi woatsɔ aɖu ɖe?

faq.q: Ðe nuɖuɖu ƒe ɖoɖo nye esia?
faq.a: Ao. Ele ŋdi ƒe gbɔgbɔ ƒe kpekpe ɖoɖo ko, si wòle be nàgblɔ nu ɖe dzi alo nàtsɔ ɖe zi ɖuɖu. Mele gblɔm be ame aɖeke nadu nu kae o.

faq.q: Ðe woakpɔ alo woaɖo nu si míetia kpekpewo ɖe?
faq.a: Ao. Agbɔ la nɔa ɖoƒe sia ko. Womekpɔa ɖa, womeɖoa wo ɖe afisia o, eye wo ƒe gbɔ kpɔ le ne èdzudzɔ ɖoƒe la.

faq.q: Ðe ɖoɖo ɖe zi ɖuɖu le ŋu?
faq.a: Ɛ̃. "Tɔ mía ŋdi ƒe nuwɔƒe" tɔa kpɔ ɖeka ɖe A4 alo US Letter zi dzi. Efia kpekpewo si nètia kple ŋkɔ si ŋu nèkpɔ ɖa ɖe ame ɖeka ɖeka ŋu, eye kpodzi ɖe nu bubu si wòtsɔna ɖe ɖoɖo ŋu.

faq.q: Ðe wòle gratis, eye ŋu ɖea nyemi ɖe?
faq.a: Ɛ̃, wòle gratis, eye ŋu ɖea ŋkɔ, alo nyemi ɖe, alo ɖe ɖoɖo nam ɖa o. Wòdɔa le web browser me le fɔnɔ, tablet alo komputa dzi.

howTo: Tsɔ "Tia fotowo" eye nàtia fotowo eve alo wu. Bia ame si mate ŋu aƒo nu ɖe o be woadi be woaɖe foto ɖe eme.
Trɔ kpekpewo to "Kpekpe yome" kple "Kpekpe si gbɔ" alo ŋutiŋɔnu ƒe asiwo ƒe nuɖeɖe dzi.
Ɖo nyatakaka sue aɖe ɖe foto ɖe ta ne èdi. Tsɔ "Ɖe ŋgɔ" alo "Ɖe yometiti" be nàtrɔ nusi nɔ ɖoɖo me.
Tsɔ "Kpɔ ɖekae" be nàɖe nuwɔnawo ɖa, eye nàkpɔ agbalẽa kple ame bubu ɖekae.
Tsɔ "Ɖo ƒe nuŋlɔɖi" be nàaɖo kpe zi ɖe, alo "Tu agbalẽa" ne èwu wò dɔ. Naneke maɖi o.

Mina ame la nagblɔ nya ʋeʋĩ ɖe kpukpui ɖe ŋu, ne ɖeka pɛ hã lɔ, eye nàŋlɔ wo ɖe ale si wògblɔ wo ɖe ɖoɖoe me.
Ne woƒo kpukpuiwo ɖe agbalẽ dzi la, woate ŋu aɖo wo ɖe akpa aɖe me, eye ƒomea ate ŋu aƒo nu ɖe wo ŋuti kple wo ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkɔ̃wo.

faq.q: Ðe míaƒe ŋkɔ̃wo alo nyatakakawo dzi wotsɔna, wotsɔna ɖe dzi, alo woɖea ɖe ame bubu?

Tsɔ "Bigger picture" be ŋɔŋlɔ ɖeka ko naɖe ɖe ɖe, eye "Show everything" be nu bubuwo nagaɖe ɖe ɖe.
Ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe "Done for now" ne èdi.
tips: Na ame la ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe: ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe, eye tsɔ Next.
Ne ame geɖe le ɖe ɖe, tsɔ "Bigger picture" ɖe television alo screen gã dzi, eye nɔ afi si ame sia ame ate ŋu akpɔe.
Naneke ɖoɖo aɖeke nye nu si wòle be nàkpɔ ŋɔŋlɔ ɖe ɖe ɖe. Ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe nye dɔ blibo.

faq.q: Ðe ɣeyiɣi alo ŋutinya le ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Ao. Naneke ɣeyiɣi, ŋutinya, ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe alo ɖe ɖe ɖe o. Àte ŋu ayi ɣe sia ɣe, eye ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe ɖe.

faq.q: Ðe ɖe ɖe ɖe alo ɖe ɖe ɖe?
faq.a: No. There is no sound, and nothing moves, fades or changes by itself. A picture changes only when you press a button.

faq.q: Ɖe ɖoɖo si wowɔ ɖe paper dzi le?
faq.a: Ao. Esia nye kpɔɖeŋu si míakpɔ ɖekae ɖe skrin dzi. Foto alo kaɖa si nèlɔ̃ si nètsɔ ɖe tabla dzi wɔa nu ɖesiaɖe kee.

faq.q: Ɖe wòxɔ ɖe gɔ̃ o, eye ɖe ele be nàŋlɔ nkɔ̃ ɖe mɔnu me?
faq.a: Ẽ, wòxɔ ɖe gɔ̃ o, eye mahiã be nàŋlɔ nkɔ̃, nàɖo ŋutɔ alo nàɖo ɖe ɖe o. Edɔa ɖe web browser ƒe ɖoɖo dzi ɖe telefon, tablet alo komputa dzi.

color-wash.intro: Kpɔ ɖeka kple akpa sisi ɖeka. Tia kɔlɔ kple akpa gbɔgbɔ, azɔ ɖe kpɔ dzi ɖe kɔlɔ sisi ɖe dzi. Kpɔ la menɔ mɔ ɖe ɖe o: menɔ nu si nàwu o, menɔ nu si nàɖe ɖe nyui o, eye menɔ nunya o hã. Kpɔ yeyee ɖeka nàɖe ɖe kɔlɔ sisi geɖe, alo nàɖe asi ɖe fofo eye nàkpɔ ɖe. “Kpɔ yeyee” klɔa nu sia nu blibo, eye “Ɖe gbɔ” ɖea kɔlɔwo gbɔ.
howTo: Tia kɔlɔ ɖeka. Kɔlɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe ŋkɔ le ɖe edzi.
Tia “Gã” alo “Gã ŋutɔ”. “Gã ŋutɔ” kpɔa kɔlɔ ɖe kpɔ akpa geɖe dzi ɖe nu ɖeka ke.
Ɖa asi, mouse alo pen ɖe kpɔ dzi ɖe kɔlɔ sisi ɖe dzi.
Alo, ɖe arrow keys ɖe ɖe akpa ƒe ɖeƒe dzi, eye ɖe Space ɖe ɖe akpa ɖe alo tsɔ ɖe.
Ɖe “Kpɔ yeyee” ɖe kpɔ ɖe ɖe, eye “Ɖe gbɔ” ɖe nèdi kɔlɔ sisiwo gbɔ.
tips: Ɖe ame bubu nàtia kɔlɔ ɖe kɔlɔ sisi ɖe ɖe, eye ɖe kɔlɔ ɖe nu gbɔ kple wo.
Gã ŋutɔ nyui ɖe asi si dzi ɖe ɖe, elabena akpa mahiã be nàkpɔ nyui o.
Kpɔɖeŋu ɖeka mele nɔnɔme nyui ɖeka o. Ɖe ɖe fofo ne nèdi, alo ɖe “Ɖe ɖe fofo” ɖe.

faq.q: Ɖe nu ɖe dzi, nuɖuɖu alo ɣeyiɣi le ɖe?
faq.a: Ao. Kpɔ la menɔ nu ɖe dzi o. Naneke menɔ gbãtɔ o, menye nuɖuɖu ɖe dzi o, eye ɣeyiɣi menye ŋutɔ o, eye gbeɖeɖe aɖeke meɖo ɖe ɖe be nàwɔ nu geɖe o.

faq.q: Ɖe wole kpɔ la ɖe alo wòɖe ɖe?
faq.a: Ao. Naneke mele kpɔ, mele paper dzi, alo wòɖe ɖe afisi o. Kɔlɔwo si nèɖo ɖe kpɔ sia dzi anɔ ɖe ene va se ne nàdzo le kpɔ sia me.

faq.q: Ɖe mahiã mouse alo touch screen ɖe ɖe be nàwɔ nu?
faq.a: Ẽ. Ne kpɔ la nɔ focus me, arrow keys ɖe akpa ƒe ɖeƒe dzi, eye Space key ɖe akpa ɖe alo tsɔ ɖe. Skrin la gblɔa “Akpa ɖe ɖe” alo “Akpa tsɔ” ɣe sia ɣe.

faq.q: Kɔlɔ kae ɖe wo nye?
faq.a: Yeye, lãsi, ahɔ̃ kple vɔvɔ̃ – kɔlɔ ene siwo míeɖo ɖe mía bubu kpɔɖeŋuwo me ko. Kɔlɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe ŋkɔ le ɖe edzi, eye ŋkɔa kpɔna ɖe tia la ɖe ɖasi.
